svg.title: Ranked stock selection pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Full pipeline from raw data to portfolio evaluation, showing 7 stages: data, features, target, normalization, walk-forward training, ranking, and evaluation.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What raw data does the pipeline need?')
sendPrompt('What features are used in V4?')
g.text: RSI · MACD · BB · volume surge · market regime · macro

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the regression target constructed?')
sendPrompt('Why do we normalize returns cross-sectionally?')
g.text: zscore or rank returns within each month across 50 stocks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does walk-forward training work for ranked selection?')
g.text: Train on months 1–36 → predict month 37 returns → rank 50 stocks
Train on months 1–37 → predict month 38 returns → rank 50 stocks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do we construct the ranked portfolio?')
g.text: Sort all 50 stocks by predicted return each month

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a good hit rate for top-5 stocks?')
sendPrompt('How is the long-short spread calculated?')
sendPrompt('How do we benchmark against Nifty?')
sendPrompt('What does the final output look like?')
g.text: Monthly ranked portfolio · cumulative return chart vs Nifty
